name: OPC UA
description: Browse the OPC UA address space of PLCs and servers, then read and write node values with data type aware decoding.
releaseNotes: 0.2.0: version update of the existing io.github.yuzhi.opcua (publisher yuzhi) -- your 0.1.0 connection carries over. Security: server certificates are now verified by default; a per-connection 'trust any certificate (insecure)' toggle replaces the previous always-on trust, so username/password auth is no longer exposed to a man-in-the-middle by default. The package now bundles LICENSE (MIT) and a THIRD-PARTY notice covering the MPL-2.0 static dependencies (async-opcua 0.19). Three-column workbench with draggable splitters; Variable points can be dragged onto the board; writes wait for the session handshake, resolve the node DataType server-side, report the OPC UA status code on failure and read the value back. Editing a watched value and pressing Enter (or blurring) writes it immediately.
